description: Use only when the user requests a new animated pet from a text brief. Starts one server-paid pet generation task (twelve image stages, each with at most one delayed retry after a retryable provider failure, plus one text/vision request for an editable name, description and tags). Supply a fresh random UUID requestId; reuse it unchanged when retrying the same request. Limits: 200 accepted tasks/day globally, 10/IP by default, Moscow time. Admin IP allowances can add attempts until midnight; the global cap and budget still apply. Returns a task ID; poll get_pet_generation. The result is unlisted and expires after 24 hours. Do not use to publish a pet, edit an image, or create a manual administrator request. Experimental generation: animations and gaze directions may contain visual errors or look too similar. Review the preview before submitting your pet to moderation. Accepted tasks count toward the limit even if the result is unsuitable. A failed image stage may be retried once after a delay, which can incur an additional provider charge.
name: generate_pet
title: Generate an animated pet
